title: GLRT Detector
text: Perform generalized likelihood ratio test detection, 4 inputs, 5 outputs; {Probability of false alarm}, {Output format} sets the format of output data, {Output detection statistics and threshold}, {Enable known noise power input}, {Output MLEs of unknown signal parameters}, {Output estimated noise power} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input data real-valued N -by- 1 vector | complex-valued N -by- 1 vector | real-valued N -by- M matrix | complex-valued N -by- M matrix

ports.name: Hyp
ports.summary: Augmented linear equality constraint matrix real-valued R -by-( P + 1) matrix | complex-valued R -by-( P + 1) matrix

ports.name: Obs
ports.summary: Observation matrix N -by- P -by- D array

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Detection results D -by- M logical-valued vector | 1-by- L integer-valued vector | 2-by- L integer-valued matrix

ports.name: Param
ports.summary: Maximum likelihood estimates of signal parameters P -by- M -by- D array

params.name: Probability of false alarm
params.values: Probability of false alarm 0.1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Output format
params.values: Format of output data Detection result (default) | Detection index

params.name: Output MLEs of unknown signal parameters
params.values: Output MLEs of unknown signal parameters 0 (default) | 1

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
